description_en: Queries sensitive words by calling ListSensitiveWord
name: ListSensitiveWord

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, which is generated when you create an application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The current page number for the paged query. The value starts from 1 and increments by 1 for each subsequent page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的当前页，从1开始，每次分页查询时递增加1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The size of each paging query. Default value: 100. If the value exceeds 100, it is set to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次分页查询的大小。如果不填，默认为100，如果超过100，则被限制为100
parameters.name: page_size
